glue.developer_menu.title: Developer Menu
glue.developer_menu.needs_world: This page needs a world. Open a world and press the developer menu key again.
glue.developer_menu.framebuffers.title: Framebuffers
Which buffers the grid shows. While a depth buffer is on the grid, its preview is read back to the CPU every frame, which stalls rendering.
glue.developer_menu.framebuffers.alterna: Also shows the alternate texture of each Iris colour target, which shader programs ping-pong with.
glue.developer_menu.framebuffers.grid.de: How many buffers a side of the grid holds.
glue.developer_menu.framebuffers.page.de: The grid's page. The mouse wheel over the grid turns pages too.
glue.developer_menu.framebuffers.hud_hin: Framebuffers: open the developer menu to hide them
glue.developer_menu.raycast.title: Raycast
glue.developer_menu.raycast.overlay.desc: Draws the blocks the pick tested and its hit in the world, and the trace on the HUD. It stays on after the menu closes.
glue.developer_menu.raycast.vanilla.desc: Vanilla's hit on the blocks' outlines: block, face and distance.
glue.developer_menu.raycast.cells.descri: The hit among the cells the ray crosses, on what the blocks draw.
glue.developer_menu.raycast.final.descri: The nearest hit of all, which the game picks.
glue.developer_menu.raycast.matches.desc: Whether the final hit picks the block and face vanilla does.
glue.developer_menu.raycast.reaching.des: Blocks next to the crossed cells whose shape reaches into them, all tested too.
